image_description: A brown pelican in flight against a clear blue sky. The bird is captured from a side-front angle with wings fully extended. The plumage is primarily dark brown/grey on the body and wings, with a lighter, whitish head and neck. The distinctive long bill and gular pouch are clearly visible.
